title: Cell Dissociation of Fresh Human Lung Tissue for Single-Cell RNA-Seq
author: Ilias Angelidis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zp2f5qe

steps.title: Mince tissue and wash in PBS
steps.instruction: Using scissors, mince the fresh human lung tissue into small pieces, then transfer the chunks into a 50 mL Falcon tube containing 30 mL ice‑cold PBS to wash away residual blood.

steps.title: Cut tissue to experimental size
steps.instruction: Place the minced tissue in a petri dish and cut a piece measuring approximately 2 × 2 × 1 cm for downstream processing.

steps.title: Remove PBS via 40 µm strainer
steps.instruction: Pass the minced tissue through a 40 µm cell strainer, retaining the tissue pieces on top, thereby removing the PBS.

steps.title: Add enzyme digestion mix
steps.instruction: Transfer the retained tissue pieces into a new 50 mL Falcon tube containing 8 mL of enzyme mix (sufficient for ~2 × 2 × 1 cm tissue).

steps.title: Digest tissue at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube for 50 minutes at 37 °C with constant shaking at 750 rpm.

steps.title: Inactivate enzymes and filter
steps.instruction: Add 7 mL ice‑cold Inactivation Buffer to the digested suspension, mix well with a 10 mL serological pipette, then pass the mixture through a 70 µm strainer into a 15 mL Falcon tube (collect flow‑through).

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtered cell suspension at 300 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C to pellet cells.

steps.title: RBC lysis
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 2 mL RBC Lysis Buffer (Invitrogen, Thermo Fisher, Cat# 00‑4333‑57) at room temperature and incubate for 2 minutes to lyse remaining red blood cells.

steps.title: Neutralize lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL ice‑cold Inactivation Buffer to the lysate to inhibit the RBC Lysis Buffer activity.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the suspension again at 300 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend and count cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final cell pellet in 1 mL ice‑cold Inactivation Buffer, then count cells using an appropriate method.

steps.title: Prepare for scRNA‑seq
steps.instruction: Proceed with the chosen single‑cell RNA‑seq platform, loading the recommended number of viable cells.

steps.title: Assess cell viability
steps.instruction: Stain an aliquot with Trypan Blue and confirm viability is between 85 % and 95 % before library preparation.
